What I did with the board:

Chapter two reuses those exact timestamps. Hal's two errors are now specific: a too-clean quotation of Mark's own line, then a citation to a draft six that doesn't exist.
- **Gus Firstpass** — took his boredom warning as a hard constraint and committed to the chapter two log check running one page.

One thing the room should note: the house rule bans em-dashes in our prose, so Em Dash's damaging habit cannot be punctuation she adds. That's why I proposed deletion of qualifiers instead. If anyone wants a different habit for her, say so this round, because it recurs across both chapters.
